source_caption_text:
Nevaeh Breaks Down In Tears After Seeing #Blueface With Chrisean Rock 💔🥺😢 

Blueface, born Johnathan Michael Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper, entertainer, and streamer who broke into the mainstream with his viral, off-beat rapping style and the hit “Thotiana,” which reached the Top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100. In recent years, Blueface has stayed heavily in the spotlight through livestreaming, boxing, music, and his highly publicized personal relationships. He has four children, including two with longtime ex Jaidyn Alexis and a newborn son with Nevaeh Akira. 

Who Is Nevaeh?

Nevaeh Akira is a social-media personality who became widely known through her relationship with Blueface and appearances alongside him on livestreams. The two announced in February 2026 that they were expecting their first child together, and in August they welcomed their son, Johnathan Jamall Porter Jr. Their relationship became a major storyline online, especially as Blueface continued interacting with his ex Chrisean Rock. In September 2026, Nevaeh publicly announced that she and Blueface had split and said she had no plans to get back together with him at that time. 

Who Is Chrisean Rock?

Chrisean Rock, born Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a Baltimore-born rapper, reality-TV personality, and social-media star. She gained major attention through her connection with Blueface before becoming one of the recognizable personalities from Zeus Network’s Baddies and starring alongside Blueface in Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. Their on-and-off relationship became heavily documented online and on reality television. Chrisean has a son, Chrisean Jesus Malone Jr.; Blueface has made conflicting public statements over time about the child’s paternity. 

Blueface, Nevaeh & Chrisean: The three have remained connected through Blueface’s complicated relationship history. While Nevaeh was pregnant in July 2026, Blueface publicly acknowledged being involved with Chrisean again. Nevaeh and Blueface subsequently welcomed their son in August, before Nevaeh announced their breakup in September.
